info.description: HTTP API for Coyote CI control-plane workflows.
info.title: Coyote CI API

post.description: Retries a failed artifact-trigger delivery by delivery id.

get.description: Returns logical artifacts grouped with their available versions for artifact repository browsing.

parameters.description: Search artifacts by path, project, job, version label, or channel
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Filter artifacts by producing job id
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.description: Number of logical artifacts to skip
parameters.name: offset

get.description: Returns persisted artifact metadata rows across builds for artifact catalog browsing. Use /artifacts for the grouped logical artifact browser.

parameters.description: Search artifacts by path, name, artifact id, build id, build number, or job id
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Filter artifacts by producing job id
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.description: Filter artifacts by producing build id
parameters.name: build_id

get.description: Returns one persisted artifact instance with build, job, step, and stable download metadata.
Returns immutable version tags attached to one artifact.
Lists builds sorted by newest first with optional pagination and project filters.

post.description: Creates a new build in pending status.
Creates a new build attempt containing a retry of the failed execution job.
Parses and validates pipeline YAML, then creates a queued build with resolved steps.
Clones a repository, loads .coyote/pipeline.yml, then creates a queued build.

get.description: Returns build details by id.
Returns persisted producer-side artifact trigger delivery records for a build.
Returns persisted artifact metadata for a build.
Streams stored artifact content for a build artifact.

post.description: Marks a queued or running build as canceled and terminalizes cancellable steps/jobs.
Transitions build status from running to success.
Transitions build status from running to failed.

get.description: Returns log lines for a build.

parameters.description: Limit logs to one step index
parameters.name: step

parameters.description: Select the failed step when exactly one step failed
parameters.name: failed

parameters.description: Show only the last N log entries
parameters.name: tail

post.description: Transitions build status from pending to queued.
Creates a new queued build using the source, trigger, job, and step context from an existing build.
Transitions build status from queued to running.

get.description: Returns steps for a build.
Returns persisted log chunks for a build step.
Streams build step log chunks over SSE with cursor resume support.

post.description: Triggers builds for matching enabled jobs configured for push events.

get.description: Returns a simple liveness response.
Returns stable server metadata for remote clients.
Lists jobs with optional pagination.

post.description: Creates a new job and queues an initial build by default.

get.description: Returns job details by resolving an exact job name within a project.
get.summary: Resolve job by project and name

get.description: Returns job details by id.
Returns builds triggered by a specific job, sorted newest first.

post.description: Triggers an immediate build for a job.

get.description: Returns all targets in a job carrying the requested immutable version.
get.summary: Query job version tags by version

post.description: Creates immutable version tags for one or more artifacts and managed image versions scoped to a job.
post.summary: Create immutable version tags for job targets

get.description: Returns immutable version tags attached to one managed image version.
Returns the resolved request identity, or a synthetic disabled-mode user.
Returns the authenticated user's opt-in state for commit-author failure notifications and whether delivery is currently active.
get.summary: Get my commit failure notification preference

put.description: Sets the authenticated user's explicit opt-in state for commit-author failure notifications.
put.summary: Update my commit failure notification preference

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's opt-in state for commit-author success notifications and whether delivery is currently active.
get.summary: Get my commit success notification preference

put.description: Sets the authenticated user's explicit opt-in state for commit-author success notifications.
put.summary: Update my commit success notification preference

put.description: Enables or disables the authenticated user's owned personal email notification target without changing its address or preferences.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's linked personal Slack identity and safe workspace readiness metadata.

post.description: Confirms and persists the authenticated user's personal Slack identity after server-side revalidation.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated user's linked personal Slack identity without changing the Slack workspace integration.

patch.description: Pauses or resumes the authenticated user's linked personal Slack identity without changing the linked Slack member.
patch.summary: Enable or disable my Slack identity

post.description: Resolves a personal Slack identity candidate for the authenticated user by exact authenticated-email match without persisting it.

get.description: Lists API token metadata for the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a user-owned API token and returns the raw token only once.

delete.description: Revokes one API token owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Lists projects.

post.description: Creates a new project.

get.description: Returns one project.

delete.description: Deletes a project when it has no jobs.

get.description: Lists jobs for one project.
Lists project memberships with basic user fields.

put.description: Creates or updates a project membership.

get.description: Returns queued and running builds with project and job context.
Returns a readiness response after database connectivity and schema checks succeed.
Returns safe Slack workspace integration metadata for the instance.

put.description: Validates a Slack bot token via auth.test and stores safe workspace metadata plus credentials for the instance.
put.summary: Connect or replace Slack workspace integration

delete.description: Disconnects the instance-level Slack workspace integration and removes stored credentials.

patch.description: Enables or disables the connected Slack workspace integration without deleting credentials.
patch.summary: Enable or disable Slack workspace integration

post.description: Runs Slack auth.test using stored credentials and updates last test status.

get.description: Returns the effective instance defaults used when a newly eligible user first gets a personal email target for commit-author failure and success notifications.

put.description: Updates the instance defaults used only when a newly eligible user first gets a personal email target for commit-author failure and success notifications.

get.description: Lists Coyote users.

post.description: Creates a user without storing credentials.

get.description: Returns one user.

delete.description: Deletes a user and cascades project memberships in durable storage.

patch.description: Updates user metadata and global role.

post.description: Verifies a GitHub webhook signature and triggers builds for matching jobs on push events.
